title: The Clash of 2 Worlds On One Earth Part 1
paragraphs: The collision of two worlds on one earth. Please take notes today, because this will help you understand what I call: the mystery of colonization. This is the strategy used by Jesus Christ to colonize the earth; it is a matter of clashes. I do n't think anyone can deny that we are currently going through what we call a cultural clash. Someone sent me—in fact, our television manager sent me a DVD clip and I receive about 800 emails almost every week—but I wanted to open this one.

I don't know why I opened it and played it, and I watched it three times because what was on that video was so amazing. I decided to send it, I tried to send it to others. It is a very, very serious video. In fact, I am going to ask our television department if they can isolate that video and prepare it to show to the whole church. It is a video of an interview with a woman from the Middle East, clearly an Arab lady, and she commented on what is happening in the world today regarding Islam.

And I sat there listening to this woman, mesmerized. I thought she had read my notes. I thought she had listened to my teachings, because she said things that I had said almost word for word over the past few months. And she said that this stress we are feeling in the world now, especially regarding Islam and the conflicts in the Far East, and in Northern Turkey, and in various parts of Pakistan, and even the stress we feel in the Middle East, which has now even moved to London and is seeping through to America.

She said that this stress has more to do with not just a culture clash, but she used a term that I tried to use about 6 months ago, and that was the term a clash of eras. A clash means that the people from the Islamic tradition with whom we deal today come from an era that has never changed, and we clash with them in our modern experience. That is important because we changed, but they didn't. And they did not change because they were protected by insulation.

In other words, many of these peoples lived in places where they were in a cocoon. They were in an incubator that did not allow them to travel or make contact with Western society, as we call it. And so they truly believe that their way of life is the only way of life. And when they suddenly start making contact with the Western world, they panic and their reaction is: the Western world must be Satan.

Their conclusion is therefore that, at all costs, we must first and foremost defend our way of life and, secondly, do everything in our power to destroy this so-called satanic culture called the Western world. That is the mentality of the, uh, I want to use the term extremist Islamic mentality. However, I dare say, and I would officially declare on television, that that is probably more than 90% of the Islamic theological perspective.

Even those who are called moderate Muslims—and I don't know what you mean by that— their theology creates extremism. Although people try to be moderate in their way of relating to the Western world, it becomes difficult for them not to be extremists when it comes to their theological position, because theology itself calls upon a follower of Islam to hold certain perspectives and beliefs regarding Western culture. that results in tension and perhaps even violence. Now, I said this to say the following.

What we are discussing here today is a process. We are talking about colonialism. And I want you to pay attention to our theme of today. That is? a collision of two worlds on one earth. That is God's plan. God did not intend for this to happen. That is not God's original plan. So, let's start with a few general statements. I want you to write this down, please, if you want. Number one, God's divine strategy has not changed. And that was to extend His heavenly kingdom to the earth through humanity.

That was God's divine strategy. He wanted to extend the territory of heaven to the earth. Therefore He created the earth. Number two, He wanted to colonize the earth with the heavens. Colonization is important here. We will discuss it again in a bit more detail later. Please do not get tired of the word colonization. Please, I beg you, my loyal members who come here every week, please don't get tired of it yet, okay? For it must be burned into your psyche, into your mind.

You have to get it inside you, into your mind. Number three, his strategy was to establish a colony of heaven on earth. Please write that down again. God's idea was to establish a colony of heaven on earth. Therefore, he wanted to influence the earth with heaven through the rule of his own children on earth. All this is called strategy. Strategy means a practical plan to set things in motion. God's plan was therefore not only to create a planet, but he wanted that planet to be an expression of his culture.

And he planned to do that by placing beings on it who are exactly like him, so that they could manifest his culture. And number four, five actually, his strategy was to colonize the territory of the earth with the nation of heaven. I keep repeating this because you and I have learned that heaven is a place. Well, that is true, but in our minds, a place means nothing to us. Heaven is not just any place. Jesus referred to two specific statements that are very important. Please write them down for me.

The first statement he often referred to is the Kingdom of God. The second statement he constantly mentioned was the kingdom of heaven. Both statements are not the same, even though they are related. The phrase Kingdom of God refers to the influence of a place. The phrase Kingdom of Heaven refers to an actual place. Heaven is the name of the place where God has determined that his headquarters would be. If I may use that term again in the context of eternity.

The Bible says in Psalm 115 verse 16, it says these words: the highest heavens belong to the Lord, a specific location, but the earth He gave to the children of men, another location. So we have two different locations. The One, says God, is His territory. The other, he says, he has given to you, sons of men. It is therefore important to realize that God's strategy was to colonize the territory of the earth with the nation of heaven. Heaven is, for lack of a better vocabulary, the nation of God.

It is the place where God has his headquarters. Jesus refers to this place in a very significant way when he is asked by the disciples how we should pray. His answer was: if you pray, pray like this. And then he said about this model: first of all, you must say: our Father who art in heaven. In other words, he placed God in a place that is different from the earth. Now, theologically speaking, I hope we all agree that God is what they call, uh, omnipresent in theology. Omni means all.

So, omnipresent means that he is present everywhere. That means he is everywhere at the same time. But in this statement, Jesus apparently ignores that theological reality and places God in a specific place. He said: if you pray, pray like this. Our Father who is true? In heaven. That means that he is not on earth. He is not on Mars. He is not on Jupiter or Pluto. Now he could be everywhere at the same time.

He said: when you address God and you speak of supplicating as a country, a government, you must locate his headquarters, and that is where? Heaven. Heaven is a place. I want you to engrave that in your mind. So his plan was to colonize the earth with the nation of heaven. Why is that important?

I continue to use the Bahamas, and I believe that the Caribbean people will be some of the greatest preachers in the next 20 or 30 years, because they are qualified by history to have an advantage in understanding God's plan regarding the colonization of the earth than any other group of people, because we have become victims of colonization. Let me just say why this works. We in the Bahamas were colonized by a nation. Which nation was that? Great Britain. In fact, what was the correct name?

The United Kingdom of Great Britain, which was ruled by kings and queens, not by prime ministers. Prime Ministers are very new in England. Great Britain was ruled by kings, just as France was ruled by kings, and so were Portugal and Spain and Belgium and all those other countries we are talking about. They had no prime ministers, no presidents. They were all ruled by kings. And Great Britain was a nation. Now listen carefully. A nation colonized these islands. That is exactly what God did with the earth.

So write down number six. God's original purpose was therefore the colonization of the earth with heaven. Let's now move on to some practical matters. I am going through a lot of scripture this morning, because I was struggling to review my notes even until the very last moment. The Holy Spirit kept bringing me back to the scriptures. He said: "Son, I want you to protect yourself by reading a lot from the Scriptures this morning, for they will not believe you unless they see it in the Scriptures."

So I have to protect myself. You know, when I spoke at, uh, the 'word explosion' in Tulsa, I had to go back and look at my notes again for three hours. And I had to make sure they were filled with Bible verses, because I was dealing with people I first had to convince that the word kingdom was in the Bible. That might sound simple to you, but it was a tough job, because the people there had only learned about faith. Faith, faith, faith.

And I had to spend almost 40 minutes just reading aloud the words of Jesus about the kingdom. And I could feel during the meeting when it shifted, when people started breathing and realized: my heavens, he was really preaching about the kingdom. But it is difficult to convince people that Jesus preached about the kingdom of God if they have never been taught that he taught about the kingdom of God. Now I want you to see this. I just want to remind our visitors whether that was indeed his message.

So let's take a look at this. Matthew 6:33, Jesus said these words, please read them aloud. But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things that you need will be added to you. He said: look for something? First, what? The Kingdom of God. Okay. So we know what his priority is. Another verse, Matthew 9:35. And Jesus went through all the cities and villages, while he taught in their synagogues what? The good news about what? The kingdom.

And he healed the sick and those among them who suffered from ailments. What did he preach in every synagogue? The kingdom. Where did he go? Into every city and every synagogue, with only one message. The kingdom. Okay, so we agree: the kingdom. Now, if you were here last week, I defined the kingdom for you. And for those visiting for the first time, it is my duty to do the same. What is a kingdom?

A kingdom is the ruling influence of a king over a territory, which is influenced by his will, his purpose, and his intention, and produces a population that reflects the values, morals, and nature of the king. In other words, a kingdom is a country where the citizens assume the nature of the king and reflect his morals and values. It is a country ruled by a king. Now look at Matthew 10: 6. Please take notes here. This is new fabric. What is the purpose of colonization? Every member, please write this down.

The goal of colonization, Matthew 6:10, Thy kingdom come, Thy will be done, on earth as in heaven. The goal of colonization is to make the area exactly like the kingdom. The goal of colonization is therefore to reproduce the culture, the language, the lifestyle, the values, the morals, and the true nature of the kingdom in that area.

When Christ says, "Your kingdom come, Your will be done," He did not tell us to start a few religious groups in the city, to have people gather once a week on Saturday or Sunday to sing some songs and listen to a few sermons, and then go home and live like hell for the rest of the week. No, He said: "Look, I want an invasion that endures, and I do not want that invasion to be religious. I want it to be a complete takeover of a culture. Thy kingdom come." Let me rephrase it.

I have done a lot of research into the word colonization, because the Bible speaks about it. Colonia is a Greek word used in the New Testament. And this is an important word. Write this down. Colonization is, first and foremost, the expansion of a king, his influence, and his rule over a distant territory. Please write that down. What is colonization? It is the expansion of a king's influence and his rule over a distant territory.

That is why the British came here and left a governor with us to ensure that their influence was preserved and their impact endured. Secondly, colonization is the establishment of the kingdom and the government of a king in a distant domain. Not just the influence, but the actual government. And that is the reason that the first thing the British did when they took over these islands was to build a large pink house. In other words: we are not going anywhere.

They dug a deep foundation into that hill not far from here, poured concrete, and said to the natives: " We are not going anywhere." We are here to stay. We are here to exert influence. We are here to establish a government. The most important thing they did was not only tell us that we had to govern ourselves, but they sent a white British man from England, from the courts of the king himself, and told him to give up his family, his country, and his house, and told him that he had a new headquarters.

He has a new home. He has a new heart, a new life. He is going to live on that island there in the Caribbean. And that white man came here and stayed with us our whole life. Why? Because when a kingdom colonizes, it establishes a government. Ladies and gentlemen, help me, Lord. Jesus was the king, and he stood by these 12 fishermen and farmers, and he tries to tell them what he came to do. He says: "I came to bring back the kingdom of God." And then he said to them: "The kingdom of God is now with you."

In other words, the Holy Spirit was only in him at that moment. He said: "But the day is coming, after I go to the cross and die, that he will be in you." In other words, the kingdom of God is with you. I quote him now. The kingdom of God is among you. Say that with me. Who is he referring to? The Holy Spirit. My point is this. The governor is the government. Let me quote it again. He says: the kingdom of God is among you. Well, the only person who was with them was he, full of the Holy Spirit.

He said: "And the kingdom shall be within you." That means, when the Holy Spirit comes into you after the resurrection and I cleanse you, make you holy again and back into your bladder, you receive not only a person, you literally receive a government. Does this make sense? Number four, colonization. Number three, colonization. Number four, sorry, is the reproduction of a prototype of a kingdom in a distant land. Please write that down. What is colonization? The reproduction of a prototype of the kingdom.

In other words, when colonization is successful, you no longer need to go to the kingdom to see what it is like. Just visit the area. Hallelujah. One person understood it there. Thank you very much. I remember that Philip once spoke with Jesus. Philip, you know, Philip came from Baytown. He doubted everything. Philip says: "Lord, let us see the Father." His answer, Philip, how long must I be with you? In other words, he who has seen me. Come on, people. You no longer have to go to heaven.

As soon as you encounter me and examine my culture, my nature, my values, my standards, my convictions, my belief systems, my attitude, you meet the belief system of heaven, the morality of heaven, the values ​​of heaven, the attitude of heaven. You don't have to go to heaven to meet heaven. Just run into me. He says: That is why, Jesus, I am going to look it up here a little bit now. There is no record of Jesus sneezing. I don't see any. Yes, I say that for a reason. Look, there is no virus in heaven.

I am trying to work towards something. Yes, sir. Let me tell you something. I believe in God. And this is my prayer. I... this is my personal prayer every day. I say: Lord, do not let me die until... And Lord, let it begin at Bible Ministries. Let there be a group of people where they cannot find a disease and cannot explain why. Does anyone want to believe like that? Hallelujah. You know, they look at you and they say: your grandma had it, your great-grandmother had it, but we don't see it in your genes.

And your answer will be: because I changed countries and in our country there is no DNA for that kind of disease. I am under the control of God. Call amen, someone. That will happen in the course of our lives. If you don't believe me, God did it with the children of Israel. When they obeyed him, He said: "No disease from Egypt shall be among them." And the Bible says that for 40 years none of them were sick. Call someone, say: "Let it happen to me." I say: "Scream and say: Let it happen to me."

How can a people be in a desert, a desert for 40 days, 40 years, and no one is sick? That is how it will happen to you. You know what our problem is. You know that my father is 83 years old, and I am looking at my future. Well, you don't understand what I'm talking about. I see my genes manifesting themselves and I say to God: listen, my father was born in the Baptist church, in the Brethren church, you know that church. Now, Lord, I am born into the kingdom.

So, whatever manifests itself in him, that ought to stop in my generation. I don't know about you, but that is my belief at the moment. I am meant to be a prototype of what the Kingdom of Heaven is like. And the kingdom of heaven has none of the diseases that were in Egypt. Why don't you put some pressure on God? Lift your hands and thank Him that every sickness your family carried is now leaving your body. Lift up your hands and receive it now in the name of Jesus Christ.

Every disease that was in my DNA now falls under the jurisdiction of heaven. And God is now shooting his divine healing power into my genes. So be it. Say amen, everyone. Amen means: let it be for me as you have said. O Lord, write this down. Colonization, it is an interesting thing. It is the manifestation of the culture and nature of a kingdom in a distant land. Therefore his prayer was: "Your kingdom come, your will be done on earth as it is above. Let the earth be exactly as it is above.

One thing about the kingdom, you know, it works only through faith according to your faith. Let it be done to you. So if you do not believe what I teach, it will never happen to you. God wants the culture of heaven to manifest itself on earth. Now I want you to write this down. Natural conflict of colonization. Natural conflict of colonization. Jesus Christ was the most misunderstood man on planet Earth. Everyone misunderstood him. Those who lived in his time misunderstood him. The theologians misunderstand him.

The other religious faiths misunderstand Jesus. They tried to make him one of them. All our refined scientific minds misunderstand Jesus. Our skeptics are always making news reports about him without ever having met him. Everyone seemed to have an image of him without ever having actually seen him. I mean, everyone discusses him. When you start to understand Jesus, you start to appreciate why there was a conflict. Write this down. Colonization is the conflict of one culture and lifestyle with another.

Some of you have said in your heads: since I started following Jesus, I have never had as many problems as in the rest of my life. In fact, things were going so well until you decided to get serious about Jesus Christ. You don't have problems. The problems are a sign that you are on the right path. Hallelujah. Since I went to Bahamas Faith Ministries, all hell has broken loose. You know, believe me, friends, believe me. You know, I hear about all your problems.

You know, the Holy Spirit tells me 90% of it and the other 10% comes from gossip. People just come and talk and I just listen and that's how we talk. Yeah. Did you hear what...? So I just know. But you don't have to tell me. I know what you are going through. Your marriage problems, your economic issues, losing your job, your problem. That is normal. You are being groomed for a great blessing, but you have to go through the conflict first. Amen.

You can sit moping for 20 hours and to struggle, but the Bible says: everyone who wants to live godly in Christ Jesus will undergo persecution. What is your problem? Do you want to know mine? Why would I waste my time talking about my persecution? That is on another level. You have to believe in God for a million dollars a week. You have some problems. That is my problem. But I can't call you every day, pastor. I have to pray for the pastor. He needs a million. Praise Him. That is not your struggle.

That is my level. And the same God who helped me through the 100,000 and the 50,000 can also lead me through the million- and ten- million level. Why? Because this kingdom is a kingdom without boundaries. You are blessed according to the battle you overcome. He is with you. He knows what you are going through, and He is with you in that situation. Be encouraged today. This kingdom is no escape from challenges. It loves challenges, for He who is in you is greater than He who is in the world.

And I mean that out loud. the bottom of my heart. Some of you have lost an eye and are still standing. Some of you have lost a kidney and are still worshipping. Some of you have lost a breast and the devil still cannot silence you. Some of you nearly lost your minds and you are still rejoicing. You see, we are so resilient. The devil keeps taking pieces away from us and we keep singing louder. Go on and rejoice anyway. This is no weak kingdom. I said: give Him a few seconds of praise, just to challenge Him.

Let me tell you what perfection is in the kingdom of God. Perfection in the kingdom of God is: after they beat you and hoped and thought you were dead, and they dragged you outside the city walls and dumped you on the garbage dump in a city called Lystra and left you for dead. The next morning you get up, bandage your wounds, put oil on your head and go to the next city to say: "He is still Lord." He is still Lord. That is what Paul did. Paul says: "Stop complaining." You have not yet been tested to death.

" The next day they took Paul off the garbage dump. And Paul said: " Paul said, put some oil on this and bind up my eye for me." And the Bible says, and he said to them: "Take me to the next city." And as soon as he laughed on the horse, he said: "You must know the kingdom." You must get to know Jesus. You must come to the kingdom. "They could not kill the man. Your small water bill upsets you. Sit up straight and shout hallelujah. Amen. Someone You will get through that water bill.

If you get through that water bill with the right attitude, God will give you a water company to sell water. May I hear an amen? Amen. I tell you, some of you here are going through things. God is watching you. He is not watching what you are going through. He is watching how you are going through it. He is testing your attitude, whether you are ready for great things. Please write this down. Very important. Colonization is not coexistence, but infiltration and transformation of a culture.

And here we run into problems in the kingdom of God. You see, this is where the kingdom of God ceases to be religious. Religions exist side by side. Do you know what the Muslims say? I read the Quran. It is an interesting book to read. You know that there are chapters and chapters in the Quran about Mary and about Jesus who was born of a virgin.

All those things are in the Quran, and what What they say about Jesus is that Jesus was a good man and that he was one of the prophets sent by God and that he did his part, but he did not complete the work. So the Lord had to send another whom Christ prophesied would come, and that was Muhammad. This is the Quran. Okay. So, they believe in Jesus, all those good things. I mean, you know, you talk to Muslims about Jesus. Oh, this Jesus is in the Quran. They believe in Jesus.

In other words, they know they can't get rid of him. So they decide to include him in their book. Keep the TV on, please. Now, pay attention to this. The only problem with Jesus is that he doesn't include them. You had better shout along with me a bit. Jesus says: "I am the way." I am the truth. " Are you still here with me? Let's go back for a moment. I am life. Then he says: " Nobody." "" Say it again. No one comes to the Father then—shout it out if you believe what he said. No coexistence.

The first attack is now: "Oh, you are so narrow-minded. You are an intolerant person. You are so closed off." Only ignorant people react like that. Because they do not understand the message of the kingdom. That's right. When the British came here, I need to talk to you now. When the British came to these islands, they did not say: " Well, we will exist alongside African culture." "Watch out now." So, you can, you know, you can still wear your grass skirts. You can beat your native drums.

The British said: "Quick, stop." All drums are illegal. Get rid of it. Look at him now. No more African language. Every little black boy must speak King's English. Take off those grass clothes. I don't care if it's 35 degrees. You are going to wear that tie, those shorts, and those long socks. Oh yes. You throw away those drums and we let you hold a Union Jack, and whether you see it or not, you are going to sing 'Rule Britannia'. Britannia No coexistence during colonization.

Look, let me tell you why this is important. Look, you can live together with religion. If you go to Haiti now, come on, Haitians, talk to me. You Haitian, that is who I am talking about. You can be both a Catholic and a Voodoo follower at the same time. Come on. You know that it is true. They have Catholic voodoo priests in Haiti now. So whatever your problem is, it depends on what you want. Either you want Maria or you want Shaka Zulu. Which of the two do you want?

Well, don't laugh too hard at them, because behind you are people who are also trying to live together. They come here on Sundays to sing their songs, and on Mondays they live with someone else. That's right. That's right. Just clap, you say 'amen' this morning while you don't even sleep in the same bed as your wife. No. You need to... you need to get yourself together, man. Yes, sir. No coexistence. Colonization does not strive for coexistence. It destroys culture. Hallelujah. And replaces it with his own culture.

Amen. Therefore the Bible says: if anyone is in Christ, oh come on, answer for me now. He is a new creation. Come on, keep saying it. All things. All things. Clap your hands, new creatures, and say something to God. I can hear it in a moment. But let me tell you something. Look, colonization is not about fitting in other religions. Look, Christianity can accommodate Islam. Therefore, the mullah and the Pope can meet.

Look, and then Bahá'u'lláh and the Buddha can meet in New York with the Pope and the Muslim and everyone, they can meet. They call it ecumenism, which means equality, but Jesus Christ never had anything to do with ecumenism, never in his life. I'll say it again. Jesus Christ, the one I know, has never been in that ecumenical movement. Never, never, once He said to His disciples, and this is a bold statement. Take a look at this. He says: "Whoever is not with Me," pay attention to this.

Well, he didn't even give you room to move. This is a profound statement. Of course. He did not say: if you are not with Me, then you are with someone else. He did not say that. He said: If you are not with Me, you are against Me. Of course. So you are leaving this place tomorrow. Tomorrow morning you are going to work. Can they see the difference? I mean, are you still doing the same things they do? That is, that is ecumenism. We and the sinners celebrating together. We agree that we disagree.

So we are both drinking. We swear and tell dirty stories together. You know, we have to get along. you. Well, we are supposed to love each other. That is not colonization. That is a compromise. Colonization means that you have not come to live together. When we were sitting in class, do you remember this in class? Do you remember this in class? Some of you remember this man in class? Do you remember the class? We are in a class with 36 students, one white teacher from Scotland. Continue. Colonization, right? Okay.

I say: "Hey, boy." The teacher says: "Uh, what did you say?" "Go on." I said: "Boy, what is boy?" "" Look at him now. Correct me. Uh, boy means boy. Then it is jongen, not jongen. I will never hear the word boy in this class again, or you will be beaten. He says that is correct. In other words, we must strike the folly out of some of your saints. Come on, say amen. Say, everyone: no coexistence. No coexistence. If you are righteous, you ought to be righteous, not half-righteous. Amen. Amen. Amen. Yes.

Some of you leave a gathering like this and go home and scold your wives. My Lord. Oh, I'll get back to you later. You go home and curse at your husband. You are not yet in the kingdom. You are still religious. You cannot stand here shouting, "Praise the Lord," only to go home and live with a demonic power in your kitchen. Therefore, some people in this church are not healed, because they are sitting alongside coexistence that stands in the way of their healing. No, please don't misunderstand me.

I meddle in no one's business. I just came from somewhere. Don't tell. Don't look at me. I preach with anointing. If it hurts you, say 'ouch'. I am not looking for anyone's private affairs in this church. I am God's prophetic voice. No coexistence in colonization. Hallelujah. No fornication in the kingdom of God. None of that. Young people, stop having sex now. Keep your legs together until you are married. Tell them that I am in the kingdom of God. Older people too. Oh, go ahead and clap now, because I'm watching.

Lord, help me. Praise God. Please write this down. Colonization influences and overrides the culture of the territory. We are not here to accommodate other cultures. We are here to impose the culture of heaven on earth. You know that sounds crazy, but let me tell you something. If the people of the world ever got a true picture of the heavenly culture, they would be angry with you that it took you so long to impose it. Amen. Look, what they don't want is your Christianity.

Because they saw through your hypocrisy 20 years ago already, because you slept with their niece. No one, no man in his right mind, can resist the culture of heaven. It is so beautiful. Therefore the sinners followed him. They loved his culture. Religious people hated Jesus' culture because they wanted room for compromise. Okay, that didn't come out well. Let me try it here. You see, they hated him because there was no room to coexist with your little secret affairs.

The sinner says: "If this is the life you offer, then we want you." "And he became their best friend." Religious people say: "Yeah, well Dr. Miles, you know, you're taking it too seriously." "You know," "that's why you want to be a Christian, you know, because you see that Christians don't take it so seriously." They do not want to coexist. You know, two of my dearest friends saw their marriages fall apart last week. I derive no joy from that.

And I will make some phone calls tomorrow, because I have access to them. But whatever they tell me, there is no room for coexistence. None. You cannot justify the termination of God's ordinance for your own personal ambition. No single value solves problems. We must pray for these people. They must come into the kingdom just as you come, slowly, but you will come. Praise God. Write this down. Colonization cannot accommodate the culture of another but imposes its own culture.

Let me quote a saying of Jesus that is not a pleasant one, and next week I will tell you a bit more about it. He said all power is given to me in heaven and on earth. Therefore go into all the world and proclaim the good news of the kingdom. Now pay close attention. He says: "Teach them to obey." Let me quote this again. Teach them to obey. Hey? Yes. Go to that hotel and do not live with them. You teach it to them. You make them obey the things I have taught you. That is imposing.

And so you are sitting in the boardroom at the bank and they start discussing something that is going to harm the staff, a policy they are trying to protect, and you say: "I cannot go along with that." Amen. And they said: "But, but, but, but you are one of the seniors." Yes. Yes. But that violates the conscience I have to care for people. I cannot agree with it, I cannot sign up for that. Well, we need your signature, because you know, everyone has to agree.

Well, then I think we have a choice between your world and my world. I must teach them to obey the things He taught me. Yes. Imagine Sir Ralph Gray. Do you remember him? Sir Ralph Gray. You can see how old you are. Yes. Sir Ralph Gray was one of the last governors from England here. That's right. He always wore my blue suit and never washed it. I know how I used to do that.
